knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Structures, retaining walls and gas elements may need approvals, engineering or licensed work. They are checked and marked as referred or excluded in the scope, not included without a check.
A change across a drainage line is a variation. It is checked, recorded and approved in writing before any work begins.
Installation is the physical work on site. Design is the layout and plan, and supply is the provision of materials.

practicalCriteria: Given a supplied mock site brief with one structure, one retaining wall and one planting area, the learner marks each item as in scope, referred or excluded on a mock plan within the assessor's set time.
The learner lists the approvals that a supplied mock structure might need and names the authority that issues each, with the check to make.
The learner completes a variation record for a supplied mid-project change, with the client approval step recorded before the extra work.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Annotated mock plan signed by the assessor.
Approvals list for the mock structure.
Variation record for the mock mid-project change.
stopWorkCriteria: Including a mock structure or gas element in the scope without an approval check during the assessment.
Moving a mock drainage line or service during the assessment without an approved variation.
